title: Coiling snake illusion
content: If you glance around at this optical illusion by Akiyoshi Kitaoka, the snakelike coils around the outer edge will start to move.But if you let your eyes come to a rest, the snakes come to a stop. Try looking toward one spot and 'spacing out.' Then start looking around again, and the snakes start moving.Apparently, scientists have concluded, the illusion is somehow tied to eye movements.Science News: Snakes Illusion
